# viettelcloud_lb_listener (Resource)

Manage a Viettel Cloud Load Balancer Listener.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "viettelcloud_lb_listener" "http" {
  load_balancer = { id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000" }
  name          = "http-listener"
  description   = "HTTP listener on port 80"
  protocol      = "HTTP"
  protocol_port = 80

  # Remove server_group to detach the server group from the listener.
  server_group = { id = "22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222" }
}

resource "viettelcloud_lb_listener" "https" {
  load_balancer       = { id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000" }
  name                = "https-listener"
  description         = "HTTPS listener on port 443 with TLS"
  protocol            = "TERMINATED_HTTPS"
  protocol_port       = 443
  default_tls_cert    = { id = "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111" }
  sni_tls_certs       = [{ id = "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111" }]
  enable_h2           = true
  set_x_forwarded_for = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `load_balancer` (Attributes) Load balancer that owns the listener. Changing it replaces the listener. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--load_balancer))
- `name` (String) Name of the listener.
- `protocol` (String) Protocol for the listener: HTTP, HTTPS, TERMINATED_HTTPS, TCP, or UDP.
- `protocol_port` (Number) Port on which the listener listens for traffic (1-65535).

### Optional

- `allowed_cidrs` (Set of String) List of allowed IPv4 CIDRs that can access this listener.
- `default_tls_cert` (Attributes) Default TLS certificate for HTTPS or TERMINATED_HTTPS listeners. Removing it from the configuration detaches the certificate. The backend rejects detaching it from a TERMINATED_HTTPS listener. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--default_tls_cert))
- `description` (String) Description of the listener.
- `enable_h2` (Boolean) Whether to enable HTTP/2. On create, omission sends false for HTTP and true for HTTPS and TERMINATED_HTTPS. Later omission preserves the current value. The backend always enables HTTP/2 on HTTPS and TERMINATED_HTTPS listeners, so false is rejected for these protocols.
- `listener_timeout` (Number) Frontend client inactivity timeout in milliseconds (1-2073600000). Default is 50000.
- `server_connecting_timeout` (Number) Backend connection timeout in milliseconds (1-2073600000). Default is 5000.
- `server_group` (Attributes) Default server group for the listener. Removing it from the configuration detaches the server group. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--server_group))
- `server_timeout` (Number) Backend member inactivity timeout in milliseconds (1-2073600000). Default is 50000.
- `set_x_forwarded_for` (Boolean) Whether to insert X-Forwarded-For header. Omission preserves the current value. Set false to disable it.
- `set_x_forwarded_port` (Boolean) Whether to insert X-Forwarded-Port header. Omission preserves the current value. Set false to disable it.
- `set_x_forwarded_proto` (Boolean) Whether to insert X-Forwarded-Proto header. Omission preserves the current value. Set false to disable it.
- `sni_tls_certs` (Attributes Set) Set of SNI TLS certificates. Omission preserves the current certificates. A TERMINATED_HTTPS listener needs at least one certificate: the backend rejects an omitted or empty set on create and an empty set on update for that protocol. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sni_tls_certs))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the listener was created (RFC3339).
- `id` (String) Listener ID (UUID).
- `provisioning_status` (String) Current provisioning status of the listener.
- `status` (String) Current operating status of the listener.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the listener was last updated (RFC3339).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a load balancer listener using composite ID: <load_balancer_id>/<listener_id>
terraform import viettelcloud_lb_listener.example 6f1a2c3d-4e5b-6789-abcd-ef0123456789/11111111-2222-3333-4444-555555555555
```
